text:
jamie: Heads-up — opened a tiny PR to adjust locale availability table + add data residency footnote for APAC regions. Need eyes on wording from legal and snippets for SDK/CLI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892
liam: On it. Which SDK snippet? the python or js one?
jamie: both. js needs `region: 'ap-southeast-1'` example; python needs endpoint sample + note about `X-Data-Residency: eu` header for EU-residency customers.
nina: @sara can you check the residency wording? we need to avoid 'stored in-region' vs 'processed' language.
sara: I'll take a look. prefer "processed and stored" only if legal has confirmation. otherwise use "processed in and may be stored in".
jamie: Ok added placeholder: [LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED]
liam: I have a failing lint on the sdk snippet — forgot to wrap code in triple backticks. Also the curl example needs `--header "X-Region: apac"` -> prefer actual header name `X-Data-Region`?
jamie: changing to `X-Data-Region`. Also switching curl to this:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Data-Region: ap-southeast-1" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","model":"redwood-1"}'
```
docs-bot: PR 4892 updated by jamie — added code fence, revised header name
nina: I pushed an amendment to region matrix: added `ap-northeast-3` as coming soon. pls ensure we mark 'coming soon' not 'supported'.
jamie: done — used blue badge 'coming soon' and added footnote 3 linking to residency FAQ: https://redwood.ai/docs/residency-faq
liam: One more: links in the Migration guide still point to `old-endpoints.redwood.ai`. Need to update to `api.redwood.ai`. I can push a small commit to the branch.
jamie: Yes please. Also can someone sanity-check that the migration snippet includes both host header and SDK config? current snippet only shows host.
liam: I'll add this to my commit.
sara: LGTM except remove 'guaranteed' from one sentence. Replaced with 'expected under our current controls'.
jamie: :thumbsup: will merge after liam updates and a final pass from nina/legal.
nina: I can review after liam's commit. ETA 1h.
jamie: thanks all. tagging @oncall-docs to watch for merge conflicts during release window 16:00-18:00 PT
oncall-docs: noted — will hold merges if release in progress
jamie: merged at 1901234598 - quick note: if anyone notices the SDK examples rendering weird on mobile, file a bug and I'll revert.
liam: spotted: mobile rendering ok. thanks.
